eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Oregon; at 2:01 PM on AUG 20, 2021 Effective until 3:01 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Oregon State Police has requested activation of the Emergency Alert System for an AMBER Alert for Arson Mangum 6 years old and Manson Rowley 8 years old.  The victims were abducted from Price, Utah on August 18, 2021 at 1:00 am.  The suspect was driving a 2004 Gold Chevrolet Silverado, Washington license C 6 6 7 8 0 T which is possibly hauling a White 5th Wheel Travel Trailer, Washington license 5 1 3 1 1 A E.  The suspect has been identified as Derek Michael Rowley.  Suspect physical description: 33 years old, 6 feet tall, with blonde hair, unknown clothing description.  The victim is Arson Mangum, 6 years old last and Manson Rowley, 8 years old and were both last seen wearing a unknown color pajamas.  If you have any information about this incident, please contact the Oregon AMBER Alert Tip Line at 1 8 6 6 5 A M B E R 5, 1-866-526-2375 or call 911.  This has been an activation of the Oregon Emergency Alert System.
